source_row.rationale: Spironolactone reduces potassium excretion and can cause hyperkalemia. Current labeling specifically identifies potassium supplementation and potassium-containing salt substitutes as risk enhancers and recommends serum-potassium monitoring after initiation/titration and regularly thereafter.
